content:
nina: found hostNetwork=true in a private deploy canary. edge-agent can curl 127.0.0.1:10250 and GET /pods. can we treat as high severity? :warning:
sam: can you paste a minimal repro and confirm what data is returned?
nina: minimal: `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:10250/api/v1/pods` returns pod specs for node-local pods, includes volume mounts and serviceAccount names. not secrets contents but enough to target SA tokens.
omar: immediate mitigations: 1) apply host-level iptables rule to block 127.0.0.1:10250 egress from edge-agent, 2) create a NetworkPolicy to deny egress to 127.0.0.1:10250 for edge-tenant namespace, 3) push agent image update to remove hostNetwork. note: NP may not block hostNetwork pods on some CNIs.
sec-bot: [alert] RULE: KUBELET_LOCAL_ACCESS flagged for template v0.9.3.
jia: KMS ops: run decrypt audit for principals matching edge-agent SA between 2024-03-01T00:00Z and 2024-03-02T00:00Z. if decrypts exist, capture ciphertext IDs and rotate.
irene: incident plan: 1) triage and mitigations (4hr canary), 2) full fleet rollout in 24hr if confirmed, 3) legal hold if any customer data exposed. assign owners.
sam: I'm taking the canary netpol + CRB audit. command: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name=="edge-agent")'` then delete.
nina: adding a detection to cluster-agent: alert on pod egress to 127.0.0.1:10250 from pods with label app=edge-agent. posting to #eng-security.
omar: creating remediation ticket PRIV-EDGE-KUBELET-10250 and adding hostNetwork blocker to installer preflight.
jia: starting KMS audit queries now, will post findings.
irene: thanks. reconvene in 2h. keep updates here.
